title: 第5章 成年晚宴第6章 安琪
content_zh:
第二天。
时间悄然过去，夜晚来临。
原本灰暗偏僻的格林城堡灯火通明，一辆辆装修豪华的马车载着身穿华丽服饰的贵人，马不停蹄的赶赴格林城堡，参加为默里专门举办的成年宴会。
平静的格林城堡逐渐热闹起来，充满了人气。
而今晚的主角——默里.格林，被伯爵夫人拉着盛装打扮一番，穿着华丽的贵族长袍，脸上涂抹着昂贵的化妆品，使得默里原本就白皙的面容一片雪白，唇如鲜血般明艳。
看着铜镜前仿佛美颜开到顶，非常陌生的自己，默里.格林吞枪自尽的心都有了，没想到两辈子加起来几十岁的人，今天还有如此遭遇。
“嗯，非常棒，不愧是我的小默里，长得像我，真漂亮。”
家里面，最疼爱默里的就是母亲——彭妮·坎贝尔，与莱茵相比，默里在相貌上更像伯爵夫人，英俊帅气，还带着一丝秀气。
在血脉遗传上，伯爵夫人的家族血脉在默里的身上也体现得更多，因为默里拥有与伯爵夫人同款淡蓝色双眸，而格林伯爵和莱茵的双眸都是黑色。
“母亲，这个模样是不是太..太...没男子气概了，要不您把我的妆给卸了。”
闻言，伯爵夫人轻轻的在默里头上拍了一巴掌，略做生气道。
“哼，你是被你父亲带傻了，就知道打打杀杀，粗鲁，一点贵族礼仪都没有，等过段时间，到学校，与你的魔法师同学接触一下，就知道收敛了，你将来可是高贵的魔法师，而不是鲁莽的战士。”
伯爵夫人名为彭妮·坎贝尔，是现任坎贝尔侯爵的三女儿，不同于只有两百多年贵族历史的格林家族，坎贝尔家族可是这个国家建立之前就存在的庞大家族，是有名的魔法家族。
建国后，稳坐侯爵之位六百多年，是王国北地四大侯爵之一，底蕴深厚，与之相比，格林家族就是个暴发户。
坎贝尔家族历上出现过一名水系大魔导师，这等存在，已经可以把自身伟力溶于血脉之中，流传后世，因此拥有坎贝尔家族血脉，并能够显现出来，基本上都有成为水系魔法师的潜力。
默里的淡蓝色双眸就是坎贝尔血脉显现的证明，可惜他的发色没有像伯爵夫人一样，也是淡蓝色，而是伯爵一样的黑色，说明默里的水系魔法潜力并没有伯爵夫人高，但也有成为魔法师的潜力。
彭妮·坎贝尔是一名水系中级魔法师，擅长水系治愈魔法，并且还转职成为魔药师，能够独自炼制魔药。
而伯爵夫人对默里今后的规划也是走她的老路，成为水系治愈魔法师，将来大哥莱茵上战场的时候，亲兄弟是一名治愈魔法师，生存几率将会大幅度提升。
如果默里能够转职魔药师的话，那就更好。
“好，漂亮，今天的小默里真漂亮，不知道今晚能够迷倒多少贵族小姐。”

经过伯爵夫人两个多小时的化妆打扮，原本很帅的默里变得更加英俊，也许是他之前提的意见被伯爵夫人听取，就把他的长发用黄金发箍箍成狼尾，为其增添一份成熟的狂野气息。
……
“多谢大家来参加默里·格林的成年礼，希望各位今晚玩得愉快，享受一个愉快的夜晚，那么宴会就开始吧。”
军人出身的伯爵大人话语不多，言简意赅的对参加宴会的嘉宾表达感谢，敬完开场酒后，就下场，带着整个伯爵领的贵族和骨干在大厅中央喝酒聊天，。
伯爵夫人则带着其他贵族夫人去后厅娱乐，剩下的子女就在大厅四周自由活动。
身为今天的主角，默里身边围了不少人。
“嘿！默里，成年快乐，今晚要不要给你安排一下，让你成为一个真正的男人。”
一个肥胖的身影挤到默里身旁，悄咪咪的在他耳边说道，并朝着默里挤眉弄眼起来，虽然这句话是在默里耳边说的，但是周围几人都听到了，然后这几人也开始对着默里小声调侃。
“对呀！默里，之前带你去乐呵乐呵，你说伯爵大人管得严，还没成年，今天成年了，我们兄弟几个，给你举办一个真正的成年礼。”
“哈哈。”
“......”
周围一群志同道合的小伙伴低声轻笑起来，默里·格林先是脸色一红，然后板着脸小声怒喝。
“滚，你们这群老污龟赶紧给老子滚远点。”
听着这些老污龟左边一个小男孩，右边一个不是真正的成年人，默里满脸黑线，生气的一人给了一拳，不过他这些狐朋狗友不仅没生气，反而哈哈大笑起来。
“呦，默里兄弟这是成年了，口味挑了哦，难不成你想对在场的贵族小姐下手，这可得三思而后行呀！”
“她们可是带刺玫瑰，和她们玩，你得做好结婚的准备哟！你要是有此想法，我可以忍痛把我姐姐和妹妹介绍给你，想要那个，我给她们说。”
“他家姐妹长得和他一样胖，我家妹妹你见过，漂亮吧！只要你吱一声，我就把她给你送过来。”
“你说谁姐妹胖，那是丰满，微胖才是极品，你家妹妹与豆芽菜没啥区别。”
虽然默里只是伯爵二子，只要莱茵.格林还在，他就没有继承伯爵的机会，但是身为伯爵之子，整个伯爵领的二少爷，对于未婚女子来说，抢手程度仅次于拥有贵族继承权的男子。
整个伯爵领的贵族是有限的，贵族家的小姐不说多，但数量肯定比贵族多，哪有这么多的贵族夫人给她们当。

而默里在伯爵的照顾下，除了贵族身份外，未来的日子绝对比许多贵族都过得滋润，要是跟着伯爵大人上战场走两圈，混点军功，不是没有被封为贵族的可能。
这群平时和默里玩得挺好的狐朋狗友今天也接到了任务，来撮合默里和家中的姐妹。
默里终于知道这群老污龟为啥不去找那些贵族小姐撩骚，而是一直围着他这个大男人转，身为伯爵之子，默里知道不少贵族秘闻，还以为他们今天准备换换口味，要知道今天的默里被伯爵夫人打扮得可“漂亮”了。
不行，得离他们远点，不然第二天鬼知道会出现什么流言蜚语，他两辈子的清白就毁了。
以前长得丑，没有女朋友很正常，现在长得这么帅，因为这件事，还没有女朋友，那岂不是彻底完蛋了。
content_en:
the next day.
Time passed quietly and night came.
The originally dark and remote Green Castle was brightly lit, and luxuriously decorated carriages carried nobles in gorgeous costumes, rushing non-stop to Green Castle to attend the coming-of-age banquet specially held for Murray.
The peaceful Green Castle gradually became lively and full of people.
Tonight's protagonist, Murray Green, was dressed up by the Countess. He wore a gorgeous aristocratic robe, and his face was smeared with expensive cosmetics, making Murray's originally fair face turn white and his lips as bright as blood.
Looking at himself in front of the bronze mirror, who seemed to be at the peak of his beauty and very unfamiliar to him, Murray Green felt like shooting himself. He didn't expect that a person who was dozens of years old in two lifetimes would still experience such a thing today.
"Well, it's great. It's indeed my little Murray. It looks like me. It's so beautiful."
In the family, the one who loved Murray the most was his mother, Penny Campbell. Compared with Rhine, Murray looked more like a countess, handsome and handsome, with a touch of delicacy.
In terms of blood inheritance, the Countess's family bloodline is also reflected more in Murray, because Murray has the same light blue eyes as the Countess, while Earl Green and Rhine both have black eyes.
"Mom, isn't this look too...too...unmanly? Why don't you take off my makeup?"
Hearing this, the Countess gently slapped Murray on the head and said slightly angrily.
"Hmph, you were led stupid by your father. You are known to be aggressive, rude, and have no aristocratic etiquette at all. After a while, go to school and interact with your magician classmates, and you will learn to restrain yourself. You will be a noble magician in the future, not a reckless warrior."
The Countess' name is Penny Campbell, and she is the third daughter of the current Marquess Campbell. Unlike the Green family, which only has a history of more than two hundred years of aristocracy, the Campbell family is a large family that existed before the founding of this country and is a famous magic family.
After the founding of the country, he held the position of marquis for more than 600 years. He was one of the four major marquises in the northern part of the kingdom. He had a profound background. Compared with him, the Green family was an upstart.
There has been a great water magician in the history of the Campbell family. Such beings can already dissolve their great power into their blood and pass it on to future generations. Therefore, if they have the blood of the Campbell family and can manifest it, they basically have the potential to become a water magician.
Murray's light blue eyes are proof of Campbell's bloodline. Unfortunately, his hair color is not light blue like the countess, but black like the earl. This shows that Murray's water magic potential is not as high as the countess, but he also has the potential to become a magician.
Penny Campbell is an intermediate water magician who is good at water healing magic. She has also changed her profession to become a potion master and can refine potions on her own.
The countess's future plan for Murray is to follow her old path and become a water healing magician. When her eldest brother Rhine goes to the battlefield in the future, his biological brother is a healing magician, and his chance of survival will be greatly improved.
It would be better if Murray could switch to potion master.
"Okay, beautiful. Little Murray is so beautiful today. I don't know how many noble ladies I can charm tonight."
After more than two hours of make-up by the countess, Murray, who was originally handsome, became even more handsome. Perhaps because the countess listened to his previous opinions, she tied his long hair into a wolf tail with a gold hairband, adding a mature and wild atmosphere.
…
"Thank you all for coming to Murray Green's coming-of-age ceremony. I hope you all have a good time tonight and enjoy a pleasant evening. Let the party begin."
The earl, who was a soldier, did not speak much. He expressed his gratitude to the guests who attended the banquet in a concise and concise manner. After toasting the opening wine, he left the stage and brought the nobles and backbones of the entire earldom to the banquet.Drinking and chatting in the middle of the hall.
The countess took other noble ladies to the back hall for entertainment, while the remaining children moved freely around the hall.
As today's protagonist, Murray is surrounded by many people.
"Hey! Murray, happy adulthood, do you want to make some arrangements for you tonight so that you can become a real man?"
A fat figure squeezed next to Murray, whispered in his ear, and winked at Murray. Although this sentence was said in Murray's ear, several people around him heard it, and then these people also began to tease Murray softly.
"That's right! Murray, I took you to Lehelehe before. You said that the earl was very strict and you are not yet an adult. Today you are an adult. We brothers will hold a real coming-of-age ceremony for you."
"Haha."
"..."
A group of like-minded friends around him chuckled softly. Murray Green's face turned red at first, and then he shouted angrily with a straight face.
"Get out of here, you old dirty turtles, get the hell away from me."
Listening to these old dirty turtles, there was a little boy on the left, and the one on the right was not a real adult. Murray's face was covered with black lines, and one of them punched him when he was angry. However, his friends, not only did not get angry, but laughed.
"Hey, Brother Murray is now an adult and has a lot of tastes. Could it be that you want to attack the noble lady present? You should think twice before doing so!"
"They are roses with thorns. To play with them, you have to be prepared to get married! If you have this idea, I can bear the pain and introduce my sister and sister to you. If you want that, I will tell them."
"His sisters are as fat as him. You have seen my sister. She is pretty! As long as you squeak, I will send her to you."
"Whose sister you say is fat? That means plump. Slightly fat is the best. Your sister is no different from bean sprouts."
Although Murray is only the second son of an earl, and as long as Rhine Green is still around, he has no chance of inheriting the earl. However, as the son of an earl and the second young master of the entire earldom, for unmarried women, he is second only to men with the right to inherit the nobility.
There are only a limited number of nobles in the entire earldom. There are not many ladies from noble families, but there are definitely more ladies than nobles. How can there be so many noble wives for them.
Under the care of the Earl, in addition to his status as a noble, Murray will definitely have a better life in the future than many nobles. If he follows the Earl on two rounds of the battlefield and does some military exploits, there is a possibility of being named a noble.
This group of friends who usually play well with Murray also received a task today to bring Murray together with his sisters at home.
Murray finally knew why these old dirty turtles didn't go to flirt with the aristocratic ladies, but kept hanging around a grown man like him. As the son of an earl, Murray knew a lot of aristocratic secrets, and thought they were going to have a change of taste today. You must know that today Murray was dressed up "beautifully" by the countess.
No, he had to stay away from them, otherwise there would be who knows what rumors the next day, and his innocence for two lifetimes would be ruined.
It used to be normal for me to be ugly and not have a girlfriend. Now that I'm so handsome and not have a girlfriend because of this matter, wouldn't it be completely ruined?
